an6.96:1.3: tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ, ariyāyatane paccājāti dullabhā lokasmiṃ, indriyānaṃ avekallatā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ajaḷatā anelamūgatā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, kusaladhammacchando dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an6.96:1.4: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave channaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasminti.
